Talia (Comms): All-hands in 12. Two quick asks: trim leadership bullets to 2, and confirm stream/recording fallback.
Ben (Infra): Encoder healthy. I patched an intermittent reconnect last week. Quick restart if needed: ```ssh encoder && sudo systemctl restart streamd``` (restores ~10s).
Rory (AV): Lectern mic XLR is scratchy. I have a lav and a handheld. Lav will be cleaner but requires clip-on.
Talia (Comms): Nora wants 90s intro, then 10m Q&A; demo should be last and only live if stream stable.
Nora (CEO): Yep. Intro: call out Dedicated perf gains and Private compliance checklist. Keep it extremely short.
Pri (Product): Slides uploaded: "AH_onepage_2bullets.pdf" pages 1-2. I'll prep two short answers: caching improvements and new burst credits pilot.
Rory (AV): I'll mute room monitor for first 30s to avoid bleed. If XLR fails I'll swap to lav on channel 5.
Ben (Infra): If CPU on encoder spikes, reduce concurrency: ```curl -X POST http://encoder/api/scale -d 'concurrency=2'```. Fallback stream key ready: FALLBACK_KEY_2001.
stream-bot: Reminder: recording scheduled to start in 9 minutes. Please keep mics muted until host cue.
Talia (Comms): Action list: (1) Ben keep restart & fallback ready, (2) Rory swap to lav if XLR flaps, (3) Nora & Pri rehearse 90s handoff. React with :white_check_mark: when set.
Ben (Infra): :white_check_mark: ready with commands
Rory (AV): :white_check_mark: lav on channel 5, monitor muted
Pri (Product): :white_check_mark: answers ready, slides pinned
stream-bot: Recording started at 2001122480
Talia (Comms): Thanks team 609 see you in the room.
